description: Source code for generating support packets in Mattermost, including collecting system stats, job info, permissions, plugins, metadata, and database schema.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main application struct with methods to generate support packet data.

methods.name: GenerateSupportPacket
methods.description: Generates a support packet containing system info, stats, jobs, permissions, plugins, metadata, and database schema.

methods.name: getSupportPacketStats
methods.description: Collects various system statistics such as user counts, channel counts, team counts, and webhooks, marshals into YAML.

methods.name: getSupportPacketJobList
methods.description: Retrieves recent jobs of various types and marshals into YAML.

methods.name: getSupportPacketPermissionsInfo
methods.description: Gathers permission schemes and roles, marshals into YAML.

methods.name: getPluginsFile
methods.description: Retrieves installed plugins, formats as JSON.

methods.name: getSupportPacketMetadata
methods.description: Generates and marshals packet metadata into YAML.

methods.name: getSupportPacketDatabaseSchema
methods.description: Retrieves database schema definition if using PostgreSQL, marshals into YAML.
